Local Automation Architecture

Automating the Agent on Your Local Machine Daily Before 09:15 AM IST

Configure your local Mac, Linux, or Windows workstation to execute the intelligence engine automatically every Monday through Friday at 08:50 AM IST.

1

Step 1: Python Script Deployment

Your standalone agent script market_agent.py is generated on your system. It requires standard Python 3.8+ with zero heavy external dependencies.

python3 market_agent.py --notify
2

Step 2: Crontab Schedule (Mac / Linux)

Schedule a cron job to trigger at 08:50 AM IST every weekday (Mon-Fri). Dispatches desktop alerts and generates daily Markdown & JSON reports.

50 8 * * 1-5 python3 ~/market_agent.py --notify
3

Step 3: Windows Task Scheduler

On Windows, configure Windows Task Scheduler to trigger python market_agent.py --notify with high privilege wake-timers at 08:50 AM.

schtasks /create /sc weekly /d MON..
Production Crontab Entry 
# Intraday Agent: Trigger every market day (Mon-Fri) at 08:50 AM IST
50 8 * * 1-5 /usr/bin/python3 /home/user/market_agent.py --notify --export json >> /home/user/market_agent.log 2>&1
